metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment products for your team. Perfect for detailed designs on soft apparel. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing applies full-color designs directly onto fabric, making it ideal for soft, breathable apparel like t-shirts and hoodies. Unlike screen printing, DTG handles complex artwork, gradients, and small text without setup fees. This method works best on 100% cotton garments, giving you vibrant, long-lasting prints that feel like part of the fabric. For company uniforms, event giveaways, or employee gifts, custom direct to garment products deliver sharp detail and a soft hand feel.
